title: spergula levis
intro: Spergula levis, commonly known as Smooth Wood Sorrel, is a plant species in the family Amaranthaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Spergula levis are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
